Name: Simple Festival Speed
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]✦ Simple Festival Speed ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#67E8F9]Less walking. More festival fun.[/color][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Enjoy the festival at your own pace. Simple Festival Speed adds adjustable extra movement speed while you control your farmer at festivals, making it quicker to reach stalls, friends and activities.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]⚡ Features[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]• Faster player-controlled movement at festivals.[/center]
[center]• Adjustable extra speed from [b][color=#67E8F9]0 to 10[/color][/b], with a default of [b][color=#FDE68A]4[/color][/b].[/center]
[center]• An [b][color=#86EFAC]on/off setting[/color][/b] in optional Generic Mod Config Menu.[/center]
[center]• Native collisions and diagonal movement.[/center]
[center]• Walking animation pacing that follows the increased speed.[/center]
[center]• Settings in all [b]12 built-in game languages[/b].[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🎛 Make It Your Speed[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#86EFAC]Enable faster festival walking[/color][/b] — turn the boost on or off.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#67E8F9]Extra festival speed[/color][/b] — choose a value from 0 to 10. Setting it to 0 also disables the boost.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. Without it, edit the generated config.json file. No extra hotkey is required.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🎪 Fits the Festival[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]The boost applies during player-controlled festival movement and pauses during dialogue, menus and scripted scenes.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Normal movement outside festivals and separate minigames retain their usual speed. The mod does not add a speed buff, edit festival scripts or modify save data.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]📦 Requirements[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]• [b]Required:[/b] SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer.[/center]
[center]• [b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu for convenient settings.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]🌱 Installation[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]1. Install SMAPI.[/center]
[center]2. Download and extract Simple Festival Speed.[/center]
[center]3. Place the [b]SimpleFestivalSpeed[/b] folder inside your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/center]
[center]4. Launch the game through SMAPI.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]The festival speed boost is [b][color=#86EFAC]enabled by default[/color][/b].[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#D8B4FE]Created by xSyy[/color][/b][/center]
